subject: CAGE::deform_under_load
question: Does the supplied behavioural or interface evidence materially support realization of the stated function, at the stated abstraction level?
guidance: Judge only against the evidence listed; do not use outside knowledge of the device.

owner.name: Segmented cage
owner.description: Multiple separate cage segments with lateral boundary walls defining rolling-element receiving pockets and first and second running surfaces configured to guide the pocketed rolling element (claims 2–3). Disclosed alternatives include rolling-element-, raceway-, flange-, or shoulder-guided segments; one-piece plastic molded segments; and cylindrical or tapered rolling elements (claims 4–11), without selecting a single variant.

evidence.text: Deform cage and clamp pocket roller under elevated adjacent load A load from an adjacent rolling element located outside the cage acts on the cage; represent this as a stated load condition, not as a modeled connection from the pocketed rolling elements. When the load exceeds the predetermined amount, deform the cage so the rolling element within the pocket is clamped.

payload.note: Evidence was shortlisted by lexical retrieval; similarity is NOT a verdict.
